## What changed or decided
- **`scripts/shiki_runtime.py` › `resolve_default_branch_ref`** — inverted the base preference to `origin/<name>` **before** local `<name>`, and added a best-effort `git fetch origin <name>` (`check=False`, non-fatal) before resolving. This mirrors `shiki_loop.py`'s closeout path (fetch + cut from `origin/main`). The stale local branch is now only a fallback; the same named `ShikiError` still fires when neither ref resolves (message reordered to match). Docstring rewritten — the old "consistency with `git diff --cached main`" rationale was wrong because that local ref is the stale one.
- **`tests/test_worktree_base.py`** — added two defect-pinning cases plus a shared builder `_repo_with_remote_ahead_of_local` (local default exists but lags its remote): `test_prefers_remote_tracking_ref_over_stale_local` (resolve returns `origin/main` at the remote tip while local stays stale) and `test_cuts_from_remote_tip_when_local_default_lags` (a worktree through `ensure_physical_worktree` lands on the remote tip, not the stale local tip). Renamed the now-contradictory `test_prefers_local_default_branch` → `test_resolves_local_default_when_no_remote_tracking_ref` (the offline fallback case). Kept the existing absent-local fallback case.
- **Scope respected:** only the two allowed files changed; `shiki_loop.py` untouched (its `rev-list --count main..HEAD` at line 437 is the same bug class but a separate, out-of-scope finding).

- **TDD:** red confirmed (`'main' != 'origin/main'`) → fix → green.
- **CCA/MergeGate:** pending PR-side CI. Local runs are diagnostic per the constitution — durable evidence requires the push + checks on #187.
